meta_title: SEG Locksmith & Secure | Emergency Locksmith Manchester

hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out or Damaged Locks
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or business in Manchester? We arrive fast, assess the situation, and get you back inside without unnecessary damage.
services_heading: Complete Locksmith & Security Services in Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to full security upgrades, we handle residential and commercial lock and key work across the city.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home or office? We're on call round the clock. Most callouts resolved in under an hour with minimal or no damage to your locks or doors.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or worn locks compromising your security? We repair or replace damaged locks quickly, using quality mechanisms built to last.

services.title: Residential Lock Fitting
services.desc: Upgrading your home security? We fit everything from mortice locks and deadbolts to multi-point locking systems on doors and windows.

services.title: Commercial Security Systems
services.desc: Protect your business with professional lock installation, access control, and master key systems tailored to your premises.

services.title: Burglary Repairs & Upgrades
services.desc: After a break-in, we repair and reinforce locks and doors, then advise on security improvements to prevent future incidents.

services.title: Safe Opening & Maintenance
services.desc: Locked out of your safe or need routine servicing? We open, repair, and maintain all safe types with care and discretion.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone at midnight because emergencies don't wait for office hours.
about_para_1: SEG Locksmith & Secure has been protecting homes and businesses across Manchester for over a decade. We started because we saw how much stress a lockout causes — and how many dodgy locksmiths were charging premium rates for shoddy work. We built our reputation on speed, honesty, and doing the job right the first time.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we turn up fast, fix things properly, and don't inflame the bill. Whether you're locked out at 3 a.m. or planning a full security overhaul, you get the same no-nonsense professionalism. Many of our jobs come from repeat customers and word-of-mouth — that's how you know you're in safe hands.

reviews.text: Locked myself out in Prestwich on a Sunday evening. SEG arrived in 35 minutes, had me back inside in ten. No damage, fair price, and a genuinely helpful bloke. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called at midnight after a break-in. They came within the hour, secured everything, and gave us solid advice on what to upgrade. Professional, calm, and didn't overcharge. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Used SEG for our office security refit. They fitted new locks, a master key system, and access control. Great communication throughout, finished on time, no surprises on the bill. Will use again.
reviews.author: David K.
